correctness.rationale: The pinning of F to every commuting maximal torus follows from Nielsen exponent-row matrix A; the quotient (u,z)~(-u,-z) and push-forward of spherical×Haar measures give invariant nonergodic nu with ergodic conditional factor RP^2. Fiber Fourier orthogonality makes the bilinear weighted correlation norm exactly rho^{D_n}, D_n=min_{k!=0}(||k||_1+||A^nk||_1); even cosines realize equality and ensure quotient symmetry. Since A=M^2 with Fibonacci unimodular M, substituting v=M^nk gives the lower bound ||M^nv||_1+||M^{-n}v||_1>=L_n||v||_1. The unit vectors attain F_{n+3}; exceptional n=0,1,3 cases are handled separately. Relative L2 mixing follows by finite frequency approximation. Independently enumerated all vectors in [-8,8]^2 for n=0..10 and found exactly four ±unit-coordinate minimizers in M^n coordinates and minimum F_{n+3}; this is a bounded consistency check, not a universal lattice proof.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks alone are not an all-size theorem; the unrestricted proof and normalization were read in RESULT.md.
